cardigann.name: definitions
cardigann.label: Indexer definitions
cardigann.help: This is the repository branch the catalog follows. Unset: the catalog is not fetched.

fields.name: repo
fields.label: Git repository
fields.help: This is owner/repository on GitHub. Default prowlarr/indexers.

fields.name: branch
fields.label: Branch
fields.help: This selects the repository branch. Default master.

fields.name: refresh
fields.label: Refresh interval
fields.help: This is how often the branch is checked. Default 24h, at least 1h.

cardigann.name: flaresolverr_url
cardigann.label: FlareSolverr address
cardigann.help: This is a FlareSolverr-compatible service (trawl) that passes Cloudflare checks, e.g. http://trawl:8191. Its traffic must leave through the VPN; requests to it go through the gateway as the indexer's own.

cardigann.name: prowlarr
cardigann.label: Prowlarr
cardigann.help: This is a prowlarr instance on the LAN whose indexers the migration reader proposes as native ones. It is only read (GET /api/v1/indexer); nothing is written to it or to the settings.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Prowlarr address
fields.help: This is the prowlarr server endpoint.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: api_key_env
fields.label: API key environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names the environment variable holding the prowlarr API key. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Client type
fields.help: This selects decypharr (a debrid client: it calls a view back, and takes the grabs of versions with add_via: client) or qbittorrent (a seedbox client: accepted, but nothing sends grabs to it yet).

fields.name: url
fields.label: Client address
fields.help: This is the download client endpoint.

fields.name: username
fields.label: Username
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: username_env
fields.label: Username environment variable fallback
fields.help: This and password_env name environment variables with the client's login. decypharr reads them as an arr's: the username is the callback view's url, the password a Theatarr key for it (any login works without its use_auth). Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: password_env
fields.label: Password environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names the environment variable holding the client password. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.help: This is the download category Theatarr's adds go under; required for an add_via: client version. decypharr keys its arr settings on it: one client entry per view flavour.

fields.name: callback_view
fields.label: Notification view
fields.help: This is the view decypharr calls back (decypharr only).

fields.name: import_from
fields.label: Import finished downloads from
fields.help: This is where a finished download is imported from: mount (the default: its release folder on Theatarr's debrid mount) or download_folder (the client's folder of symlinks into the mount).

fields.name: remote_path
fields.label: Client path (remote)
fields.help: This and local_path map the client's paths to Theatarr's (an arr's remote path mapping): a content_path under remote_path is read under local_path. Both or neither, absolute.

fields.name: local_path
fields.label: Same path in Theatarr (local)
fields.help: This is where Theatarr sees the client's remote_path.

egress.name: check_url
egress.label: Exit address check URL
egress.help: This is an IP-echo endpoint. It answers the caller's address as plain text, or as JSON with an "ip" field. Its host is allowlisted automatically.

egress.name: vpn_ips
egress.label: VPN exit IPs
egress.help: This and vpn_cidrs are the expected exit addresses. At least one entry is required.

egress.name: vpn_cidrs
egress.label: VPN address ranges
egress.help: This lists the allowed VPN exit address ranges.

egress.name: interval
egress.label: Check interval
egress.help: This is the time between checks. Default 2m.

egress.name: max_age
egress.label: Maximum check age
egress.help: This is how old the last good check may be before guarded requests are refused. Default 3 × interval.

egress.name: require_vpn_for
egress.label: Require VPN for
egress.help: This lists the classes that need a good check: indexers, providers, metadata. Omitted defaults to indexers; an explicit empty list monitors without refusing requests.

import.name: arr
import.label: Sonarr/Radarr instances
import.help: This maps an arr instance name (radarr_4k_debrid) to its source settings.

fields.name: flavour
fields.label: Sonarr or Radarr
fields.help: This is radarr or sonarr.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Server address
fields.help: This is the instance base url, without /api/v3. Its host must be a LAN address (loopback, RFC 1918 or ULA), since every request carries the API key.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: api_key_env
fields.label: API key environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names the environment variable holding the instance's API key. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: version
fields.label: Version
fields.help: This is the version key the instance's titles and files map to. Several instances may map to one version; the import then reports titles whose files differ between them.

library.name: mount
library.label: Mount
library.help: This is where zurg is read.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Mount folder
fields.help: This is where this service sees the mount, e.g. /mnt/debrid. Required once Write library links is on.

fields.name: link_path
fields.label: Library link destination
fields.help: This is the mount path written into symlinks: where plex sees it. Default path.

fields.name: all_dir
fields.label: All torrents folder
fields.help: This is zurg's directory holding every release. Default __all__.

fields.name: wait_timeout
fields.label: Wait for files timeout
fields.help: This is how long an import waits for the release to appear before it alerts (it keeps waiting; no re-grab). Default 6m.

fields.name: poll_interval
fields.label: File check interval
fields.help: This is how often a waiting import looks again. Default 20s, minimum 5s.

fields.name: stat_timeout
fields.label: File access timeout
fields.help: This bounds the health sentinel's stat; a hang or ENOTCONN pauses imports and sweeps. Default 5s.

fields.name: zurg_log
fields.label: Zurg log
fields.help: This is zurg's log (read-only): an absolute file path, or the http(s) url of zurg's /logs endpoint when the file is on another host.

fields.name: zurg_log_interval
fields.label: Zurg log check interval
fields.help: This is how often a url zurg_log is fetched (each fetch returns the whole current log). Default 15s, 5s to 10m. A file is followed every 2s whatever this says.

fields.name: zurg_log_budget
fields.label: Zurg log budget
fields.help: This names a budget for the fetches of a url zurg_log. Optional.

fields.name: zurg_api
fields.label: Zurg API address
fields.help: This is zurg's base url (e.g. http://zurg:9999), read-only: GET /debug/torrents, /api/library/entry and /torrents/repair/status only.

fields.name: zurg_api_interval
fields.label: Zurg API check interval
fields.help: This is the longest an answer of zurg_api is reused: the torrent listing and the repair state are fetched at most once per interval, when a pass needs them. Default 1m, 10s to 1h.

fields.name: zurg_api_budget
fields.label: Zurg API budget
fields.help: This names a budget for zurg_api requests. Optional.

fields.name: zurg_api_repair_grace
fields.label: Zurg repair wait
fields.help: This bounds how long a running repair keeps dangling links from being marked dead: past it the sweep marks them as it would without the API. Default 2h, 10m to 24h.

fields.name: rclone_rc
fields.label: rclone remote control
fields.help: This is the mount's rclone remote control (rclone rc): the now playing page reads core/stats and vfs/stats (docs/design/now-playing.md); forget_release_root lets an import clear one cached listing. Optional.

fields.name: url
fields.label: rclone address
fields.help: This is the rc base url, e.g. http://rclone:5572.

fields.name: username
fields.label: Username
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: username_env
fields.label: Username environment variable fallback
fields.help: This and password_env name the basic auth credentials (--rc-user, --rc-pass). Optional. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: password_env
fields.label: Password environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names the environment variable holding the rclone remote control password. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Budget
fields.help: This names a budget for rc calls. Optional.

fields.name: forget_release_root
fields.label: Clear cached release root listing
fields.help: This clears rclone's cache of the release root (vfs/forget; its subfolders and parent too) when zurg_api lists a torrent the mount does not show yet, at most every 3s. Default false.

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.label: Maximum size
fields.help: This limits how many bytes are read per file. Default 16 MiB, 1 to 256 MiB.

library.name: sample
library.label: Sample detection
library.help: This tunes the sample and fake guard.

fields.name: min_runtime_ratio
fields.label: Minimum runtime fraction
fields.help: This rejects a file shorter than this share of the title's (or episode's) known runtime. Default 0.5; 0 < x <= 1.

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Check video resolution
fields.help: This rejects a file whose probed resolution is two or more steps under the release's (a 2160p release holding a 720p file). Default true.

fields.name: mislabel
fields.label: Refuse mislabelled remuxes and 2160p
fields.help: This refuses a file whose probe plainly contradicts its Remux or 2160p label (an x264/x265 CRF encode named Remux, 1080-line video named 2160p). Default true.

library.name: trash
library.label: Trash
library.help: This is where replaced links are moved aside (upgrades, relinks). Required once Write library links is on.

fields.name: dir
fields.label: Folder
fields.help: This is absolute, outside every library root (plex must not scan it) and outside the mount.

fields.name: keep_days
fields.label: Days to keep deleted files
fields.help: This is the number of days before a moved-aside link is removed for good (the link only; debrid content is never touched). Default 30.

library.name: plex
library.label: Plex
library.help: This is the plex server scanned after a change. Optional.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Plex address
fields.help: This is the plex server endpoint.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Token
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: token_env
fields.label: Token environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names the environment variable holding the plex token. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Budget
fields.help: This names a budget for plex calls. Optional.

fields.name: debounce
fields.label: Scan delay
fields.help: This coalesces scans of one folder. Default 30s.

fields.name: now_playing
fields.label: Now playing
fields.help: This follows plex's sessions for the now playing page (docs/design/now-playing.md). It only reads, so it does not need library.enabled. Default true.

fields.name: prewarm
fields.label: Preload next episode
fields.help: This reads the head of the next episode of a show being watched through the mount, about a minute into an episode, and raises an error inbox item when that episode is missing or unreadable; past half of the episode it reads the next one…

fields.name: prewarm_rate
fields.label: Preload speed limit
fields.help: This caps the pre-warm's whole-file read of the next episode, in bytes per second (25MB: 25 MB/s), so it never starves a live stream. Default 25MB.

fields.name: prewarm_max_size
fields.label: Maximum preload size
fields.help: This limits whole-file preloading; larger episodes get only a header check. Default 20GB.

library.name: versions
library.label: Versions
library.help: This lists, per version key, where the library may write and which plex section shows it. A version not listed here never gets a write.

fields.name: plex_section
fields.label: Plex library ID
fields.help: This is the plex library section id that shows this version's root. 0: no scans.

library.name: relink_interval
library.label: Library link check interval
library.help: This is how often theatarr serve looks for dangling links and repoints them. Default 1h, minimum 10m.

library.name: dangling
library.label: Broken links
library.help: This configures the read-only report of dangling links into the mount.

fields.name: interval
fields.label: Check interval
fields.help: This is the time between reports in theatarr serve (one at start). Default 6h, minimum 10m.

fields.name: roots
fields.label: Folders to check
fields.help: This lists folders walked besides the version roots, read-only: the libraries the arrs still own and decypharr's downloads (for example /media and /downloads).

metadata.name: overrides_dir
metadata.label: Metadata overrides folder
metadata.help: This points at external data. Legacy relative values resolve beneath the policy base.

metadata.name: sources
metadata.label: Sources
metadata.help: This lists metadata services by name.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Source address
fields.help: This is the metadata service endpoint.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: api_key_env
fields.label: API key environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names the environment variable holding the service API key. Environment variable fallback.

fields.name: budget
fields.label: Budget
fields.help: This names the request budget for this service.

fields.name: per_run
fields.label: Titles per refresh
fields.help: This caps the titles one run fetches. Default 200.

fields.name: interval
fields.label: Refresh interval
fields.help: This is the time between scheduled runs. Default 6h, minimum 10m.

fields.name: prewarm
fields.label: Artwork sizes to preload
fields.help: This fetches each filled title's poster at this size into the image cache, so grids load at once. Default w342; "off" turns it off.

metadata.name: series
metadata.label: Series
metadata.help: This schedules the series metadata refresh (seriesmeta.go).

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: This turns the refresh on; default true when a tvdb or tmdb source is configured.

fields.name: interval
fields.label: Refresh interval
fields.help: This is the time between due-series sweeps. Default 1h, minimum 10m. Which series are due follows sonarr's ShouldRefreshSeries (continuing every 12h, ended monthly).

fields.name: per_run
fields.label: Series per refresh
fields.help: This caps the series one sweep refreshes. Default 50.

metadata.name: lists
metadata.label: Lists
metadata.help: This schedules Radarr collections and TMDb import lists.

fields.name: interval
fields.label: Refresh interval
fields.help: This is the time between refreshes. Default 24h, like Radarr.

notify.name: allow_hosts
notify.label: Allowed destination hosts
notify.help: This lists the hosts (host or host:port) an installed notification may target. Each joins the gateway's allowlist. Empty: installed notifications are stored but never sent.

notify.name: budget
notify.label: Budget
notify.help: This names the budget every webhook request takes a token from (optional).

notify.name: retries
notify.label: Retries
notify.help: This is how many times a failed delivery is retried. Default 5, 0 to 20.

notify.name: poll
notify.label: Delivery check interval
notify.help: This is how often the notifier looks for new events and due deliveries. Default 15s, 1s to 10m.

notify.name: targets
notify.label: Notification destinations
notify.help: This lists webhook targets defined in the policy, by key.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Destination URL
fields.help: This is where payloads are POSTed. Its host joins the gateway's allowlist.

fields.name: views
fields.label: Sonarr/Radarr views
fields.help: This lists the arr views (keys of views, or v/<version>) whose arr-shaped payloads it gets.

fields.name: native
fields.label: Send Theatarr events
fields.help: This sends Theatarr's own per-version events (JSON, eventType theatarr.*).

fields.name: format
fields.label: Message format
fields.help: This is the message format: empty for the payloads above, or discord for Discord messages (the url is a Discord channel webhook): instant health and error alerts, the daily digest and request ready. A Discord target takes no views.

fields.name: events
fields.label: Events
fields.help: This limits what this target is sent to the events chosen. Empty: all.

fields.name: versions
fields.label: Versions
fields.help: This limits native events to these versions. Empty: all.

fields.name: auth_header
fields.label: Authorization header
fields.help: Stored credential. Leave unchanged to keep the current value.

fields.name: auth_header_env
fields.label: Authorization header environment variable fallback
fields.help: This names an environment variable holding the Authorization header value, when the target needs one. Environment variable fallback.

notify.name: digest_at
notify.label: Daily digest time
notify.help: This is the local time (HH:MM, the container's TZ) the daily digest goes to Discord targets. Default 09:00.

playlists.name: enabled
playlists.label: Enabled
playlists.help: This allows playlist writes in plex, together with library.enabled. Default false.

playlists.name: orders
playlists.label: Watch orders
playlists.help: This lists the order kinds that get a playlist: release, watch, story. Default [watch, story].

playlists.name: routes
playlists.label: Create alternate route playlists
playlists.help: This gives each alternate route of the watch order (Fate's routes) its own playlist. Default true.

playlists.name: skip_optional
playlists.label: Skip optional
playlists.help: This leaves out optional rows (recaps, side stories, shorts). Default false.

playlists.name: name
playlists.label: Playlist name template
playlists.help: This is the playlist title; {franchise} and {order} are replaced. Default "{franchise} ({order})".

playlists.name: franchises
playlists.label: Franchises
playlists.help: This limits the sync to these slugs; empty: every built franchise.

playlists.name: interval
playlists.label: Sync interval
playlists.help: This is how often theatarr serve syncs. Default 6h, minimum 1h.

provider_sync.name: interval
provider_sync.label: Sync interval
provider_sync.help: This is the time between syncs. Default 6h, minimum 15m.

router.name: cached_only
router.label: Only add cached releases
router.help: This skips a provider where a release is known to be uncached (an earlier refusal, a cache check) and asks TorBox to add only if cached.

router.name: alldebrid_delete_uncached
router.label: Delete uncached AllDebrid adds
router.help: This lets "Only add cached releases" delete an uncached AllDebrid add the router believes is its own. Default false: the add is kept, it finishes downloading on AllDebrid, and the next provider is tried.

router.name: cached_grace
router.label: Cached download startup wait
router.help: This is how long the router waits before reading a fresh Real-Debrid or AllDebrid add again when the first read shows it still converting or downloading (one re-read; on Real-Debrid also after selecting files), before it calls the add…

router.name: stalled_after
router.label: Stalled download timeout
router.help: This fails a download still in state added (accepted, not ready, nothing fetched yet) this long after its add, as stalled (decypharr's remove_stalled_after): its hash is blocklisted for the version, our own Real-Debrid add is deleted,…

router.name: downloading_timeout
router.label: No progress timeout
router.help: This fails a download in state downloading whose provider progress has not risen for this long (a dead swarm, a magnet that never leaves the provider's queue): its hash is blocklisted for the version, our own Real-Debrid add is deleted…

router.name: ready_timeout
router.label: Ready files timeout
router.help: This fails a download still ready this long after ready_at, blocklists it and searches again. Default 6h, 1m to 7d. No torrent is deleted on the provider.

router.name: miss_ttl
router.label: Remember uncached results for
router.help: This is how long a release missed on every provider stays a miss. Default 6h, 10m to 7d.

router.name: poll_interval
router.label: Download check interval
router.help: This is how often added downloads are read back from their provider. Default 1m, 15s to 1h.

router.name: max_candidates
router.label: Maximum candidate releases
router.help: This caps how many accepted releases of one search are tried, best first. Default 5, 1 to 50.

router.name: trackers
router.label: Trackers
router.help: This lists public tracker announce URLs added to every debrid magnet. Default none: the magnet is bare. Each must be udp, http or https with no credentials, no query and a path of "" or /announce.

router.name: wanted
router.label: Automatic wanted searches
router.help: This is the search loop for the active versions' missing and cutoff-unmet titles and episodes.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: This turns the loop on. Default: on when some version is active, off otherwise.

fields.name: interval
fields.label: Search interval
fields.help: This is the time between rounds. Default 15m, 5m to 24h.

fields.name: per_hour
fields.label: Searches per hour
fields.help: This caps the loop's searches (one title, season or episode each) in any hour. Default 10, 1 to 200.

fields.name: again_after
fields.label: Wait before searching again
fields.help: This is how long an item waits before it is searched again. Default 24h, 1h to 30d.

fields.name: missing
fields.label: Search for missing files
fields.help: This searches items with no file (default true). Which items with a file are searched for an upgrade is the upgrade search target below.

fields.name: cutoff_unmet
fields.label: Upgrade search target
fields.help: This chooses automatic upgrade searches: quality, score or off.

router.name: cache_evidence
router.label: Provider cache results
router.help: This is what the router and the release views know about which providers hold a release cached.

fields.name: ttl
fields.label: Remember cached results for
fields.help: This is how long a provider's answer that a release is cached is remembered, per release and provider. Default 24h, 1h to 7d.

fields.name: torbox_check
fields.label: Check TorBox cache
fields.help: This asks TorBox, with our own key, whether the best releases of a search are cached.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: This turns it on. Default true; it does nothing without a TorBox provider whose key is set.

fields.name: top
fields.label: Maximum releases checked per search
fields.help: This is how many hashes of one search are checked, best first. Default 10, 1 to 100.

fields.name: per_hour
fields.label: Cache checks per hour
fields.help: This caps checkcached requests in any hour. Default 60, 1 to 1000.

shadow.name: import_interval
shadow.label: Sonarr/Radarr import interval
shadow.help: This is how often the arr.import job reads the import.arr instances (incremental). Default 15m, minimum 5m.

shadow.name: rss_interval
shadow.label: RSS feed check interval
shadow.help: This is how often the shadow.rss job reads the rss feeds of the shadow and active versions' indexers (it is also production rss for active versions). Default 15m, the arrs' default rss sync interval; minimum 10m.

shadow.name: rss
shadow.label: Check RSS feeds
shadow.help: This turns the shadow.rss job on or off. Default on.

shadow.name: search
shadow.label: Search after Sonarr/Radarr grabs
shadow.help: This turns our own search per arr grab on or off. Off, each grab is only decided. Default on.

shadow.name: searches_per_hour
shadow.label: Searches per hour
shadow.help: This caps our shadow searches (one per title, every indexer of its versions) per clock hour. A grab over the cap waits for the next hour. Default 20, 1 to 200.

shadow.name: search_reuse
shadow.label: Reuse search results for
shadow.help: This is how long one title's search results serve later grabs of the same title (the other version's arr grabs the same movie). Default 6h, at most 24h.

shadow.name: keep_results
shadow.label: Results to keep per grab
shadow.help: This is how many decided search results are stored per grab (best first), besides the arr's release. Default 10, 1 to 50.

shadow.name: link_window
shadow.label: Wait for matching Sonarr/Radarr grabs
shadow.help: This is how long an rss pick waits for an arr grab of the same version before it counts as "we'd grab, arr didn't". Default 24h, 1h to 7 days.

torrents.name: scan_roots
torrents.label: Folders to scan
torrents.help: This lists library roots other tools manage. The usage check walks them for symlinks into the debrid mount (library.mount), reading only the link targets, never the mount, so a torrent such a library uses is not offered as unused.

torrents.name: backup
torrents.label: Backup
torrents.help: This schedules backups of the provider torrent lists. Off unless backup.every is set.

fields.name: every
fields.label: Backup interval
fields.help: This is the interval of scheduled backups; 0 (the default) is off. Minimum 1h.

fields.name: keep
fields.label: Backups to keep
fields.help: This is how many backups are kept (scheduled, by hand and before a delete alike); those from the last week are kept besides. Default 30.

ui.name: images
ui.label: Images
ui.help: This configures the image cache on disk.

fields.name: dir
fields.label: Folder
fields.help: This is the cache directory, absolute. Default: images next to the database (/data/images in the container).

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.label: Maximum size
fields.help: This caps the cache; the least recently used files go first. Default 2GiB, minimum 16MiB.

fields.name: original
fields.label: Allow original-size images
fields.help: This allows the "original" size (full-resolution files, often several MB). Default false.

record.name: enabled
record.help: Disabled records stay validated but are not used. New records default to disabled.

record.name: priority
record.help: Search order; lower numbers are searched first. Default 0.

record.name: secret
record.help: API key or token. Write-only: responses show secret_set. Omit to keep the stored value; clear_secret: true removes it.

config.name: kind
config.help: Adapter: torznab (Prowlarr feeds), dmm, torrentio, zilean, seadex, or cardigann (a catalog definition run natively).

config.name: url
config.help: Endpoint URL. Every outbound URL is configured; nothing has a default.

config.name: privacy
config.help: A label for badges, filters and sorting. Unset shows as private, except on the built-in public sources (Torrentio, DMM, Zilean, SeaDex), where it shows as public.

config.name: providers
config.help: Providers this indexer's releases may go to (provider keys); empty means every provider of the library. The TorBox cache check only sends its hashes when TorBox is allowed.

config.name: budget
config.help: Key of a budget shared by the sources that name it.

config.name: page_cap
config.help: Pages per search; 0 means no cap.

config.name: min_seeders
config.help: Torrent minimum; default 1 (leave empty), 0 disables the check.

config.name: multi_languages
config.help: Languages a MULTI release holds, by arr language name.

config.name: arr_names
config.help: Other names for this indexer, as the arrs' history or a release push gives them (e.g. "DMM RD (Prowlarr)"); matched without regard to case.

config.name: proxy
config.help: Optional egress proxy (http:// or socks5://); the VPN guard checks the exit through it.

config.name: seadex
config.help: SeaDex scoring.

fields.name: best
fields.help: Weight of entries marked best. Default 100.

fields.name: dual_audio
fields.help: Weight of dual-audio entries.

fields.name: size_weight
fields.help: Below 0 favours smaller entries, above 0 larger ones.

fields.name: exclude_tags
fields.help: releases.moe tags that drop an entry.

fields.name: tags
fields.help: Weights by releases.moe tag.

config.name: definition
config.help: Catalog id of the definition this indexer runs (GET /cardigann/definitions).

config.name: settings
config.help: The definition's non-secret settings, name=value. Secret ones (password, cookie, API key) go in the credential as a JSON object.

config.name: hosts
config.help: Hosts other than the site's that the definition reaches (the catalog lists them); they join the gateway's allowlist.

record.name: enabled
record.help: Disabled records stay validated but are not used. New records default to disabled.

record.name: secret
record.help: API key or token. Write-only: responses show secret_set. Omit to keep the stored value; clear_secret: true removes it.

record.name: orphan_active_downloads
record.help: Required on provider updates, deletes and imports: true confirms that disabling or removing a provider fails its active downloads; false refuses such a save.

config.name: kind
config.help: Debrid service.

config.name: order
config.help: Fallback rank, 1 first, unique. Libraries list providers in this order.

config.name: url
config.help: Provider API base URL.

config.name: budget
config.help: Key of a budget shared by the sources that name it.

config.name: pacing
config.help: Limits on adds.

fields.name: adds_per_minute
fields.help: Adds per minute.

fields.name: uncached_adds_per_hour
fields.help: Uncached adds per hour.

fields.name: cooldown
fields.help: Pause after a refusal.

fields.name: backoff_max
fields.help: Longest back-off after failures.

fields.name: min_gap
fields.help: Least time between two adds. Default: Real-Debrid 20s (measured), none elsewhere; 0s off, at most 10m.

config.name: stalled_after
config.help: This provider's stall timeout (router.stalled_after). Default: AllDebrid at least 25m (healthy uncached jobs sit at zero for about 10 minutes), the others the router's value; 0s off, else 1m to 24h.

config.name: magnet_limit
config.help: How many magnets the account may hold, for Admin › Torrents and a health warning at 90%. Report only. Default 5000, 1 to 1000000.

config.name: requests
config.help: Requests per period (token refill).

config.name: per
config.help: The period, such as 1m or 1h.

config.name: burst
config.help: Bucket size; default 1.

config.name: hourly
config.help: Hard cap per UTC hour; 0 none.

config.name: daily
config.help: Hard cap per UTC day; 0 none, not below hourly.

rules: Every write sends generation (from the last read); a stale generation answers 409.
Unknown fields are refused. Global switches, library modes, views (/settings/view-bindings) and the other policy sections (/settings/sections) have their own settings editors and confirmations.
Secrets are write-only; *_env names are import-only.

Tests make outbound calls through the gateway (configured VPN requirements, budgets, back-offs); they never save or enable a source. No egress section turns the VPN guard off; require_vpn_for: [] monitors only; omitted require_vpn_for defaults to [indexers].
Testing changes to a saved source at a new scheme, host or port needs secret again; the stored credential only goes to the saved address.
